title: The Apology — EN/MI/FR (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar trilingual storytelling 100bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan vocal English Maori French language learning warm observational
lyrics:
[Intro - piano, soft and careful]
He said the wrong thing at a dinner party
In November
It was not a large thing
But it was a thing

[Verse 1 - English]
He practised the apology for three weeks
He refined the opening sentence four times
He moved the acknowledgement from verse one to verse two
He tested several transitions
By the third week he had something precise, warm, and true
He called the number, she answered
She said — oh that, I'd completely forgotten
I honestly hadn't thought of it since

[Verse 2 - Te Reo Māori]
I whakarite ia i tana tūtohu mō ngā wiki e toru
(He practised the apology for three weeks)
I āta whakarite ia i ngā kupu tuatahi
(He carefully refined the opening words)
I tono ia ki a ia, ka hua mai tana reo
(He called her, her voice came through)
Ka mea ia — āe, kua warewaretia e au tērā
(She said — yes, I had completely forgotten that)
Kāore i mahara ana ki tērā i muri mai
(I had not thought of it since)
Nōna i tū ai ia, ā, roa rawa atu
(He stood there, for quite a long time)

[Chorus - Français]
Elle a dit oh ça, j'avais complètement oublié
(She said oh that, I'd completely forgotten)
J'avais complètement oublié tout ça
(I had completely forgotten about that)
Elle a dit oh ça, j'avais complètement oublié
(She said oh that, I'd completely forgotten)
Je n'y avais honnêtement pas pensé depuis
(I honestly hadn't thought of it since)
Il se tenait dans le couloir
(He stood in the hallway)
Pour un long moment
(For quite a long moment)
Elle a dit oh ça, j'avais complètement oublié
(She said oh that, I'd completely forgotten)

[Bridge - all three]
The apology was excellent — Ko te tūtohu he pai — Les excuses étaient excellentes
He has kept it — Kei a ia tonu — Il l'a gardée
He is not sure what for — Kāore ia i mōhio he aha — Il ne sait pas pourquoi
He filed it under A — I tāia ki raro o te A — Il l'a classée sous la lettre A

[Outro - piano, one note at a time]
He went to another dinner party in March
He said nothing remarkable
Ka pai
Très bien
